# CC0 prototype engine recordings

These files are redistributable under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 public-domain dedication. Attribution is not required, but Heritage Engine records provenance permanently.

## Racing engine loops

- Author: `domasx2`
- Source page: https://opengameart.org/content/racing-car-engine-sound-loops
- License displayed by source: CC0
- Upstream description: loops remade from a public-domain recording; the six files are pitch variants.
- Original filenames: `loop_0.wav`, `loop_1_0.wav`, `loop_2_0.wav`, `loop_3_0.wav`, `loop_4_0.wav`, `loop_5_0.wav`
- Heritage filenames: `loop_0.wav` through `loop_5.wav`

## Engine startup

- Author: `looneybits`
- Source page: https://opengameart.org/content/car-engine-start-up-02
- License displayed by source: CC0
- Original filename: `engine_start_up_01.wav`
- Heritage filename: `engine_start_up.wav`
